title: AI Data Brain
tagline: Voice-native intelligent data platform with MCP
description: Architected a multi-modal data platform with chat, voice, and manual editing flows, powered by MCP integrations and realtime updates.
fullDescription: Built with Next.js + Django + PostgreSQL and MCP tooling to enable natural-language, voice-native data operations. The platform reduced manual data entry by 80% and improved data query turnaround from around 5 minutes to under 10 seconds in production usage.

metrics.impact: ~97% faster data query flow and 80% less manual entry

title: WordPress AI Agent
tagline: RAG-powered engineering assistant for WordPress teams

fullDescription: Built to reduce context switching across docs, debugging, and implementation tasks. The assistant was validated by 40+ engineers and helped reduce troubleshooting time by 60% in practical engineering usage.

title: Clear Vocal
tagline: AI-assisted vocal isolation with async workflow pipeline
description: Developed a full-stack audio processing application with queue-based workflows, async file handling, and responsive upload/playback UX.
fullDescription: Implemented a production-grade ML-integrated platform using Next.js, Node.js/Express, and MongoDB, integrating external AI signal-processing APIs and containerized deployment workflows.

metrics.impact: Improved reliability across long-running audio tasks

title: Focus Dictionary
description: Built a local-first dictionary extension with IndexedDB caching and API fallback for fast inline definitions.
fullDescription: A TypeScript-based Chrome extension focused on speed, privacy, and distraction-free UX. Uses local dictionary data with fallback APIs and has become the most starred public project on the profile.

metrics.performance: Instant local lookup with API fallback
